verdict.rationale: Text was extracted verbatim from several public bamf.de guidance pages: the English start page, the German start page, and the Migration and Residence topic node. This implies the public reading surface returned readable, server-rendered content to an unauthenticated fetch. However, nothing in the pack documents the access conditions, so the absence of a bot wall, JS-only shell or CAPTCHA is inferred rather than shown. missing for 10: explicit hands-on confirmation of fetches with an identified agent user agent, evidence of no bot wall or CAPTCHA, confirmation that content is not JS-gated, any first-party robots/AI-agent access policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
